patch_description: This version crosses over the strongest ideas from the prior runs: shorter lookbacks, rolling z-score normalization, regime-change features, and a controlled increase in model expressivity without reverting to the heavy regularization that caused prediction collapse. The feature set stays under the 80-feature cap while emphasizing regime-invariant signals and interaction terms such as momentum × volatility regime. Hyperparameters are tuned to preserve generalization while giving the model a bit more capacity to recover slope on the validation regime.
